_note: Per-platform whisper-server binaries built from ggml-org/whisper.cpp v1.8.4 by .github/workflows/whisper-server.yml and hosted in this repo's releases. SHA-256 verified at workflow runtime. Bump `version` whenever URL or SHA changes — the supervisor uses it as a cache-busting key (writes <bin-dir>/.whisper-manifest-version on install, invalidates the cached binary on mismatch).

macos-x86_64._note: FerriScribe itself only ships macOS arm64. macOS x86_64 office-server admins must build whisper-server from source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp#server
